description: Only Spork's boots show beneath a loose mound of stone; his muffled instructions are sincere and completely backward.
dialogue: If you lift the blue rock first, I think the rest become less on top of me.
outcome: Once freed, Spork thanks every rescuer individually and hurries toward the safest-looking exit.
reward: A stoppered vial of antitoxin he found before the collapse.
hook: The rubble conceals recent tool marks from someone widening this passage.

setup: A cage with an optimistic prisoner
description: Spork sits inside a rusted hanging cage, attempting to reach its latch with a bent spoon.
dialogue: Good news: the spoon is improving. Bad news: the lock remains very experienced.
outcome: He accepts help with enormous relief and insists the spoon belongs to the dungeon.
reward: A packet containing two uses of basic healer's supplies.
hook: Spork heard workers arguing about a blocked route nearby.

description: Spork dangles from a knotted rope above a short but alarming drop, apologizing whenever the rope creaks.
dialogue: I have tested the knot extensively. It continues to be a knot.
outcome: After being hauled up, he coils the rope badly and leaves it for the party.
reward: Fifty feet of serviceable hempen rope.
hook: Scratches below mark a narrow ledge leading around the drop.

description: A barrel quietly asks whether the dangerous part is over; Spork's eyes then appear beneath its lid.
dialogue: I was practicing storage. It became hiding when I heard the noise.
outcome: He emerges, dusts himself off, and points out the direction from which the noise came.
reward: A wrapped ration and a small flask of clean water.
hook: Spork heard heavy movement beyond one of the exits.

description: Spork grips a wall lever with both hands, convinced something unpleasant will happen if he releases it.
dialogue: I pulled it to help. I am now helping continuously.
outcome: Careful inspection lets the party secure the mechanism and free him without consequence.
reward: A brass maintenance key that fits common service panels.
hook: The lever controls an old ventilation shutter elsewhere in the district.

description: Spork struggles to drag an abandoned explorer's supply bundle away from an unstable patch of floor.
dialogue: Nobody was attached to it, but it looked as though somebody might miss it.
outcome: With help, he brings the bundle to safety and leaves its useful contents with the party.
reward: One common adventuring gear item chosen by the DM.
hook: The bundle bears the mark of a recent expedition.

description: Spork is trapped inside a collapsed one-person tent and calmly narrates his attempts to find the entrance.
dialogue: This tent has more inside than I expected and less outside than I require.
outcome: The party can unfold him and the tent in moments; he departs grinning.
reward: A tin of strong tea sufficient for one short rest.
hook: The abandoned camp was vacated in a hurry.

description: After the fighting, Spork unfolds himself from a niche far too small for comfort.
dialogue: I was not participating. I was being extremely flat.
outcome: He offers thanks and shares what he noticed while hiding.
hook: Spork saw one creature repeatedly watching a particular exit.

description: Spork stands motionless beside the hazard, holding a tiny red flag where he believes it is safest.
dialogue: I marked the dangerous bit. Unfortunately, I am now standing beside the marked bit.
outcome: Once the danger is handled, he gives the flag to the party with solemn gratitude.
reward: A bright red warning flag on a collapsible rod.
hook: Spork noticed older warning marks that someone deliberately scraped away.

description: Spork wears a dented bucket as a helmet while trying to crawl from beneath broken furniture.
dialogue: I chose head safety. I did not account for seeing.
outcome: Freed from the wreckage, he keeps the bucket and offers the party his spare supplies.
reward: A candle, chalk, and twenty feet of twine.
hook: One broken furnishing contains a concealed maintenance label.

description: Spork crouches behind the nearest crates, rubble, furniture, barricade, or debris with several packs and pieces of ordinary equipment piled around him.
dialogue: Good, you look like the previous owners. I was safeguarding these. Please handle the dangerous part while I continue safeguarding.
outcome: Once the danger passes, Spork proudly reveals that he sorted the recovered equipment alphabetically—by emotional significance.
hook: Finders, keepers... mostly.

description: Spork stands beside heaps of ordinary equipment and enthusiastically warns the party not to step where he already watched someone fail.
dialogue: Excellent timing. I was safeguarding these. Also, do not put your foot there. Or there. That third place is probably fine.
outcome: After the hazard is addressed, Spork presents the collection and admits that it came from the recently emptied guard stores.
hook: Finders, keepers... mostly.

description: Spork calmly sorts packs, weapons, armor, tools, and travel gear into categories understood only by him.
dialogue: You look like the previous owners. I sorted everything alphabetically. By emotional significance. I was safeguarding these.
outcome: Spork is delighted to discuss every recovered belonging and is more interested in a good trade or story than extracting payment.
hook: Finders, keepers... mostly.

description: A goblin in a spotless work apron sweeps debris into precise piles without looking up from the task.
dialogue: Mind the third pile, please. That one has been sorted by sharpness.
outcome: The Job Goblin finishes the aisle, checks a box on a clipboard, and moves on.
reward: A clean, unobstructed path through the room.
hook: His work order lists a nearby area as overdue for inspection.

description: The Job Goblin carries a ladder and a crate of fresh torches, replacing each burned stub with professional efficiency.
dialogue: Illumination request was marked urgent. They are all marked urgent.
outcome: He leaves the room better lit and records the party as temporary occupants.
reward: One fresh torch and a box of dry tinder.
hook: The replacement schedule skips one corridor without explanation.

description: The Job Goblin paints a room number over three older numbers, measuring every stroke with a ruler.
dialogue: Renumbering directive. Please disregard any numbers still visible underneath.
outcome: He completes the lettering, posts a wet-paint notice, and packs his brushes.
hook: The crossed-out numbers suggest this section has been reorganized repeatedly.

description: The Job Goblin taps nearby stone and timber with a tiny hammer, noting each sound on a form.
dialogue: It is approved for ordinary peril. Extraordinary peril requires Form Nine.
outcome: He marks the safest visible route with white chalk.
reward: Advantage on the DM's next check to identify unsafe construction here.
hook: A margin note mentions settling stone near another chamber.

description: The Job Goblin studies the hazard from behind a portable safety screen and compares it with a thick manual.
dialogue: Yes, it is doing that. No, the manual says it should not.
outcome: After the party makes the area safe, he identifies the proper shutoff or bypass.
reward: A practical clue about the hazard's counterplay.
hook: The same system connects to another room in this neighborhood.

description: Once the immediate threat is over, the Job Goblin arrives with a wheeled bin and begins documenting the damage.
dialogue: Please leave recognizable pieces in separate piles. Inventory gets particular.
outcome: He identifies an overlooked but mundane item among the remains.
reward: One useful piece of common adventuring gear chosen by the DM.
hook: His incident form names a supervisor station deeper in the dungeon.

description: The Job Goblin applies mortar to an ancient crack whose edges continue well beyond his ladder.
dialogue: Temporary repair. Estimated duration: longer than my shift.
outcome: He completes a neat patch and asks the party not to lean on it until tomorrow.
hook: The crack carries a faint draft from an unmapped space.

description: The Job Goblin pushes a handcart stacked with labeled boxes and checks every doorway against a delivery manifest.
dialogue: I can accept one reasonable work request while I am in the area.
outcome: He will consider one modest maintenance task the DM can remember for a future appearance.
reward: A stamped receipt declaring the party authorized recipients of one mundane supply.
hook: One crate is addressed to a location not shown on ordinary dungeon signs.

description: The Job Goblin polishes a battered display of old armor, working around every dent rather than disguising it.
dialogue: Historical damage is not dirt. Different department.
outcome: He points out which piece remains structurally sound, then returns to polishing.
reward: A small tin of protective weapon and armor oil.
hook: One dent matches an unusual weapon shape.

description: The Job Goblin stretches a measuring tape across a crack, frowns, and starts again from the opposite wall.
dialogue: It was wider yesterday. That is outside acceptable tolerances.
outcome: He files an escalation notice and advises the party where not to stand.
reward: A precise warning about unstable terrain in this room.
hook: The measurements imply slow movement in the surrounding architecture.

description: The Stranger sits comfortably on a low stone, cutting an apple into careful, equal slices.
dialogue: A journey can be measured by what you still choose to share.
outcome: He offers a slice, listens to any answer, and departs during the next distraction.
hook: He glances once toward the least inviting exit.

description: The Stranger patiently mends a worn strap on an old pack, using thread the color of ash.
dialogue: Most failures announce themselves softly before they become loud.
outcome: He finishes the stitch, tests it, and leaves the repaired pack where it can be found.
hook: The pack contains dust from a different dungeon district.

description: The Stranger waits beside a small kettle with more cups than he appears to need.
dialogue: Hospitality is sometimes an answer to a question nobody asked.
outcome: He shares the tea, asks where the party feels most at home, and is gone when the cups are collected.
hook: One cup bears an old maker's mark from the surface.

description: The Stranger rests two fingers against a wall as though taking its pulse.
dialogue: Old places remember pressure better than names.
outcome: He invites one character to listen, then steps away without explaining what he heard.
hook: A patient listener can hear water, machinery, or distant movement at the DM's choice.

description: The Stranger studies a travel chessboard with only seven pieces remaining.
dialogue: The difficult move is rarely the one that wins immediately.
outcome: He asks which piece the party would save, accepts the answer, and closes the board.
hook: One piece has been placed to indicate the direction of a nearby route.

description: The Stranger hums a slow melody while cleaning dust from an otherwise unremarkable seat.
dialogue: Some songs survive because nobody agrees on the words.
outcome: He listens if the party supplies a verse, then leaves before the melody resolves.
hook: The tune is faintly echoed by air moving through one exit.

description: The Stranger stands between two paths, regarding neither as though it were more important.
dialogue: Which door would you choose if you knew both led somewhere useful?
outcome: He considers the party's reasoning, thanks them, and chooses neither visible exit.
hook: His question draws attention to signs of traffic the party might otherwise miss.

description: The Stranger shields a tiny lamp whose flame burns steadily despite the dungeon air.
dialogue: Light is most useful when it shows you what you hoped was not there.
outcome: He lets the party use the lamp to inspect the room, then extinguishes it between two fingers.
hook: The brief light reveals an old repair or concealed seam at the DM's discretion.

description: The Stranger balances five rough stones in a narrow tower that should not remain standing.
dialogue: Patience is not waiting. It is choosing what not to disturb.
outcome: He leaves the tower behind; it falls only after everyone looks away.
hook: The stones came from several different nearby environments.

description: The Stranger folds a clean bandage beside a cup of water and watches the room settle into silence.
dialogue: Being ready to help is different from expecting harm.
outcome: He offers the bandage to whoever needs it most, asks no questions, and slips away afterward.
reward: A single use of basic healer's supplies.
hook: The water is fresh and came from somewhere nearby.
